what_it_shows: Home audio opens with 19+ sub-categories: Receivers & Amplifiers, Home Speakers, Computer Audio, TV Sound Solutions, Audio Components, Turntables & Accessories, DACs, Preamps & Power Amps, High-resolution Audio, Home Stereo, Multi-room Audio, Smart Home, Table Radios & Stereo Systems, Power Protection, Headphones, Karaoke, Cables, Accessories; TVs and headphones are separate top-level departments

TV & Audio has 16 children: Fernseher, Beamer (projector), Audiokomponenten, DVD/Blu-ray, Radios, Kopfhorer, Audio-Systeme, Lautsprecher, Car Hi-Fi, accessories, Portable Audio, TV reception, DJ equipment & instruments, Vinyl; accessories split per host device

Recommended Components: categories (digital processors, preamps, power amps, integrated amps, loudspeakers, subwoofers, headphones, complete systems, cables, accessories) each ranked Class A (A+ for hi-res/turntable/phono/headphones), B, C, D; class by performance incl. test bench, price not explicit
IEM ranking: rank S-/A/B/C/D/F tiers, separate Tone Grade and Technical Grade, value star rating, driver setup (e.g. 2EST 4BA 1DD), signature, MSRP, status; a single-reviewer consensus tier

TV family tree: two roots LED(LCD) and OLED; LED has VA and IPS(ADS) sub-types; OLED has WOLED and QD-OLED; Mini LED, QLED, Micro LED, RGB Mini LED are listed as other/marketing types; marketing names per maker (QNED, ULED, Triluminos)

Digital audio player (DAP) category: facets for storage medium, capacity, playback time, hi-res, Bluetooth, balanced output; maker and series facets (WALKMAN A/WM1/ZX series); spec filters DAC, amp, Bluetooth codec (LDAC, aptX); user review and ranking sub-pages
Audio top category page (only maker chips Sony Panasonic Toshiba JVC Yamaha Sennheiser and related categories audio software, batteries, power strips, instruments); tree itself not rendered

ASR electronics list: device-type vocabulary (ADC/Soundcard, CD Player, DAC (Dedicated), Headphone Amp (Dongle), Headphone AMP, DAC+Headphone AMP, Power AMP, Amplifier, AVR/AVP (Pre Pro)); one spec number (SINAD in dB) plus Recommended yes/no; 1,431 records

HS 8518 groups loudspeakers (single/multiple in enclosure), headphones and earphones, audio amplifiers, sound amplifier sets with microphones; 8519 record players; 8521 video players; 8522 pickup cartridges as parts; 8527 radio receivers; 8528 monitors, projectors, TV receivers

Headphone form factors (circumaural, supra-aural, earbud, in-ear), open/semi-open/closed back, wired vs wireless/TWS, noise isolation/cancellation, transducer types (moving-coil, electrostatic, electret, planar magnetic, balanced armature, others)
r/headphones classification: backing (open/closed), form factors (circumaural, supra-aural, universal IEM, custom IEM), then transducer technology (planar magnetic etc.)

Hi-fi tree: Hi-Fi Separates (system deals, amplifiers & receivers, CD players, DACs, wireless streaming separates, tuners, turntables, mini hi-fi), Hi-Fi Speakers (bookshelf, floorstanding, active/powered, in-wall/ceiling, outdoor, subwoofers), Hi-fi accessories (cables, stands, interconnects, turntable preamps); TVs/projectors, home cinema and headphones are separate top-level departments

Home cinema & soundbars Type facet: soundbars by channel layout (2.1, 3.1, 5.1), by feature (Bluetooth, wall mounted, Dolby Atmos, compact, all-in-one, multi-room), plus AV separates, home cinema speakers, home cinema systems; separate facet for premium audio tech (Dolby Atmos, DTS:X) and voice control (Alexa, Google Assistant); brand facet

Sound appliances (음향가전) split into HIFI/AV speakers, DAC/amp, soundbar, PA sound, microphone, all-in-one speaker, audio/player, AV receiver, earphones/headphones, accessories; earphones/headphones are split in the tree into wired/wireless earphones, wired/wireless headphones, PC headset, AirPods/Galaxy Buds, accessories

Chinese headphone taxonomy: wearing style first (in-ear, semi-in-ear, flat-head earbud, ear-hook, over-ear/on-ear, bone conduction), then driver principle (dynamic, balanced armature, hybrid dynamic+BA, electrostatic, planar, electret), then enclosure (closed, open, semi-open); lists hybrid (圈铁) as its own principle class

Turntable guide: first split by price tier (entry under $400, mid $400-800, top $800+) as buyer guidance; key features drive (belt vs direct), operation (manual/semi/fully automatic), cartridge (MM/MC), phono preamp (built-in, in receiver, in powered speaker, separate), USB output

Speaker guide: system role first (2-channel stereo vs home theater 5.1/7.1/Atmos), then passive types (bookshelf, floor-standing, center, surround, height, in-ceiling/in-wall, outdoor) versus powered/active (powered stereo, sound bars, powered subwoofers); driver layout (2-way/3-way)

Projector guide: choose by use first (movies, on the go, office, gaming), then resolution (HD Ready, WXGA, Full HD, 4K), screen size, connectivity; retailer categories home cinema/gaming, 4K, HD, short throw, portable

Hi-fi modularity: separates (preamplifier, power amplifier, integrated amplifier, receiver, tuner, turntable, CD player, cartridges, tonearms) versus integrated/mini/midi/music-centre systems; audiophiles prefer separates; monoblock; see-also list of home audio devices (AV receiver, boombox, cassette deck, radiogram, shelf stereo, table radio)

Museum object-type vocabulary: radiograms, radios, record players, gramophones, radiogramophones filed under category Sound Reproduction; televisions under Television; radio under Radio Communication; makers facet (Braun, Decca) - maker and era are facets

Smart speaker defined as a loudspeaker plus integrated virtual assistant; subtype smart display (touchscreen) from 2017; may act as smart-home hub (Thread, Matter); grouped by assistant platform (Alexa, Google Assistant, Siri, Bixby, Clova, Yandex Alice)

TV facets: 種類 first (8K LCD, 4K LCD, 4K organic EL, Full HD, HD, tunerless TV), then panel type (IPS, VA), backlight technology (LED, mini LED), backlight type (edge, direct), quantum dot, screen size, viewing distance, tuners (BS 8K, BS/CS 4K, terrestrial); maker then series (REGZA, BRAVIA, VIERA, AQUOS)

Integrated amplifier is its own category (217 products) under kaden/audio with spec facets: hi-res, built-in DAC, supported impedance, rated output, phono input, pre-out, headphone out; shows separates as a standalone category

Chinese speaker listing mixes smart speakers (Xiaomi, HomePod mini), Bluetooth speakers, karaoke/party speakers (JBL PartyBox) and soundbars in one 音箱 category; filter on 音箱类型 (computer, HiFi, laptop, Apple, outdoor, WiFi, bedside), channel system (mono, 2.0, 2.1, 5.1), function (Bluetooth, USB, FM)

HiFi.de topics: HiFi Elektronik (Vollverstaerker, Endstufe, Plattenspieler, Streaming-Verstaerker), AV-Receiver, Gaming, plus speakers, headphones, TVs; editorial trend note that integrated devices (amp + speakers) replace classic separates

German specialist retailer top categories: Stereo-Verstaerker, Lautsprecher, Plattenspieler, AV-Receiver, HiFi-Anlagen, HiFi-Kopfhoerer; TV & Video and Audio/HiFi are separate top groups; headphone type guide (Kopfhoerertyp)

TV screen types as buying choices: LED (edge-lit and full array), QLED, Neo QLED (Mini-LED + quantum dot), Mini-LED, OLED, QD-OLED, MicroLED; each given an experience-level tier (Basis, Gut, Sehr gut, Spitzenklasse, Absolute Spitzenklasse) which is a tier word attached to the technology

Headphones department (13 children) mixes axes: noise-canceling, in-ear & earbud, audiophile, wireless Bluetooth, wireless TV, true wireless, wired, sports, on-ear, over-the-ear, studio, gaming headsets; shop guide opens with form factor (over-ear, on-ear, in-ear) then connection (wired, Bluetooth, true wireless), then feature (ANC, sports, gaming)

Stereophile headphone section rates headphones, headphone amplifiers, DACs and IEMs together in one section with Class A+ at top; named forms such as Focal Utopia, HiFiMan Susvara, Stax SR-007S, Sennheiser HD 650, Focal Bathys, B&W Px8 appear with open/closed, planar, electrostatic and wireless notes

Speakers & Hi-Fi systems children: portable Bluetooth, wireless, Megasound party, multi-room, Hi-fi systems (traditional hifis); speaker category here is by use and connection rather than by cabinet form

Earphones/headphones children: true wireless, Bluetooth headphones, inner-ear, over-head, monitor headphones, wireless headphones, gaming headset, neckband, monaural earphones, surround headphones, headphone accessories; mixes form, wireless and use
